title: “They call me a bull for a reason,” Sexton said. …
text:
“They call me a bull for a reason,” Sexton said. … Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS “They call me a bull for a reason,” Sexton said. …
 HoopsHype Oct. 27, 2026, 10:25 a.m. ET The numbers don’t do Sexton’s brand of ball justice. Teammates report feeling his influence on the court the moment he checks in. The free agent acquisition guards like a pesky summer mosquito. He attacks like, well, the well-earned nickname he’s carried since high school. “They call me a bull for a reason,” Sexton said. “Whenever I get out on that court, it’s go time. It’s no creeping into the game.”
